name: Rooms

features.text: Draw, paint, erase, merge and split designated rooms across floors; undo/redo and draft recovery.
Room types, names and storage roles; revisioned ownership, safehouse delegation and visitor policies.
Permission and geometry API for cooperating mods; building-scoped cleaning areas.
Designated-only storage membership/geometry APIs with complete-footprint configuration permission; paired allocation-provider tests.

limits: Metadata does not grant inventory access, route items or enforce unrelated vanilla actions. Native room overrides stay removed. Native/dedicated NOT TESTED; G7/stable G8 BLOCKED.
